transaction.description: Container object capturing transaction-level logistics data including average delivery time and destination location coordinates.

Carrier Performance View.description: Fires when a user views carrier performance metrics and statistics on the platform.

purchase.description: Fires when a shipment booking is completed, capturing transit distance band and pickup scheduling confirmation.

Shipment Delay Notification.description: Fires when a shipment delay is detected, recording shipment ID, delay reason, and revised expected delivery date.

shipment.description: Container object that captures shipment identifiers and delay information associated with shipment-related events.

deliveryException.description: Fires when a delivery exception occurs, capturing address verification status, recipient availability, weather impact, and exception reason.

delivery.description: Container object capturing delivery-related attributes including address correctness, recipient availability, weather conditions, and exception details.

generate_lead.description: Fires when a user submits a freight quote request form, initiating a lead for logistics services.

begin_checkout.description: Fires when a user initiates a shipment booking process, capturing rate, account, and shipment details.

view_item.description: Fires when a user views shipment tracking details, recording shipment ID, carrier information, and tracking status.
